territory: Options-IMPLIED surface (free Cboe implied-vol/skew indices) used as a SIGNAL to trade the UNDERLYING cash ETF. No options are bought or sold.

data.signal: 21 Cboe daily implied-vol / skew indices from cdn.cboe.com (VIX, VIX9D, VIX3M, VIX6M, VVIX, SKEW, VXN, RVX, VXD, OVX, GVZ, VXEEM, VXEWZ, VXSLV, VXTLT, VXAPL, VXXLE, VXFXI, VXGDX, VXEFA)
data.underlying: Yahoo daily adjusted closes for the 15 ETFs/stocks those chains are written on
data.unavailable: Cboe daily put/call-ratio archive returns HTTP 403 (paywalled); no free GEX/dealer-positioning history exists; Deribit free-sample pipeline has 6 point snapshots only -- all three declared UNTESTABLE, not silently dropped

lag_convention.why: Cboe indices print at 16:15 ET, AFTER the 16:00 cash close. An L=1 backtest (signal close t -> earn ret t+1) is therefore NOT TRADABLE; it reads a print that does not exist yet.
lag_convention.L1: diagnostic only -- measures the 15-minute print-gap artefact
lag_convention.L2: HEADLINE. signal from close t, position established at close t+1, earns ret t+2
lag_convention.L3: LAG-KILL test -- one further day of slack

selection_rule_fixed_in_advance: a. mechanism stated in one sentence AND the position sign pre-specified from that mechanism, never read off the data
b. design-window L2 t-stat, in the PRE-SPECIFIED sign, >= bar = sqrt(2 ln N)
c. LAG-KILL: design L3 Sharpe >= 0.5 * design L2 Sharpe AND design L3 t > 0
d. STALENESS: design L1 Sharpe <= 2.0 * design L2 Sharpe (if L1 >> L2 the edge lives in the print gap)
e. only formulas passing a-d have their holdout read; a survivor requires holdout L2 net Sharpe > 0

costs.anchor: M0_AUCTION_FILLS tier-A close-print half-spread mean 1.34bp, plus slippage pad, widened for thinner underlyings
costs.charged_on: |change in weight| every day, i.e. BOTH legs of every round trip
costs.borrow_charged: on every day of negative weight, easy-to-borrow indicative ETF rates

control_formula: E4_CONTROL_uncond_reversal carries NO options information. If the gamma-sign formulas do not beat it, the option surface added nothing and they are killed regardless of t-stat.
